identification: Charlie Bears 'Anniversary True Love' (Isabelle Lee, 2020, mohair, limited edition of 200), about 60-65cm. Very shaggy long grey-lilac mohair with pink/white tipping, pale cream muzzle, dark nose stitching, pink-tipped fur round brown suede-type foot pads, bell and gold-edged tag at the neck. Compared side by side with eBay listing photos: it matches the Anniversary True Love (grey-lilac, pink-tipped feet) and not the 2015 Original True Love, which is darker chocolate-brown with a grey face and a denser coat.
